final: WITH j AS (SELECT m.college AS college, i.amount AS amount FROM income i JOIN member mem ON i.link_to_member = mem.member_id JOIN major m ON mem.link_to_major = m.major_id) SELECT college, SUM(amount) AS total_income, CAST(SUM(amount) AS REAL) / (SELECT SUM(amount) FROM j) AS fraction FROM j GROUP BY college
